Call the Spirits.theme: Daxos turns each enchantment spell into lasting experience and an army of growing Spirits.
Call the Spirits.plan: Develop mana and protective enchantments, build experience, then create Spirits while leaving mana for interaction.
Call the Spirits.mulligan: Keep three lands, a mana rock and an inexpensive enchantment.
Call the Spirits.tip: Experience counters stay with you when Daxos leaves. Spirit size follows their controller’s experience total.

Seize Control.theme: Mizzix makes large instants and sorceries affordable as your experience grows.
Seize Control.plan: Cast increasingly large spells, protect Mizzix and turn card draw into a decisive chain of damage and copies.
Seize Control.mulligan: Keep three lands, early interaction and a draw spell or mana rock.
Seize Control.tip: Experience reduces generic mana only. Choose X before paying; the spell’s mana value includes X on the Stack.

Plunder the Graves.theme: Meren builds experience from fallen creatures and brings them back at your end step.
Plunder the Graves.plan: Trade creatures for value, reuse their entry abilities and let experience turn end-step returns into battlefield advantage.
Plunder the Graves.mulligan: Keep three lands, an early creature and ramp or a sacrifice outlet.
Plunder the Graves.tip: Meren returns a creature directly only when its mana value is no greater than your experience. Otherwise it returns to hand.

Wade into Battle.theme: Kalemne gains experience from expensive creatures and becomes a vigilant double-strike threat.
Wade into Battle.plan: Ramp into large creatures, keep blockers while Kalemne attacks and use Equipment or removal to clear a finishing swing.
Wade into Battle.mulligan: Keep three lands, a mana rock and a creature you can cast before the late game.
Wade into Battle.tip: A creature spell with mana value five or more earns experience even if that spell is countered.

Swell the Host.theme: Ezuri rewards small creatures, then places your accumulated experience on another creature before combat.
Swell the Host.plan: Build a board of low-power creatures, protect Ezuri and put counters where evasion or other abilities make them matter.
Swell the Host.mulligan: Keep two or three lands, early creatures and a draw or protection spell.
Swell the Host.tip: Ezuri’s combat trigger must target another creature. It uses your experience total when it resolves.

Entropic Uprising.theme: Yidris turns a successful combat hit into cascade for spells you cast from your hand that turn.
Entropic Uprising.plan: Fix all four colors, connect with Yidris and cast from hand in your second main phase to collect cascade value.
Entropic Uprising.mulligan: Keep three lands with several colors, a fixing spell and an early play.
Entropic Uprising.tip: Yidris must deal combat damage to a player first. The cascade grant applies to later hand casts that turn.

Open Hostility.theme: Saskia chooses a player as she enters and sends extra creature damage toward that player.
Open Hostility.plan: Fix your colors, build an attacking board and choose the player you want to pressure through attacks on the rest of the table.
Open Hostility.mulligan: Keep three lands, fixing and two early creatures.
Open Hostility.tip: Saskia’s extra damage is dealt by the original creature and is not combat damage. The chosen player may also be the original defender.

Stalwart Unity.theme: Kynaios and Tiro help every player develop while your defenses buy time to use the extra resources.
Stalwart Unity.plan: Fix your colors, encourage development and protect yourself with taxes and selective removal before committing finishers.
Stalwart Unity.mulligan: Keep three lands, color fixing and a defensive or draw engine.
Stalwart Unity.tip: You always draw first at your end step. Each opponent who declines to put a land onto the battlefield draws afterward.

Breed Lethality.theme: Atraxa proliferates at your end step while the deck spreads counters across an expanding board.
Breed Lethality.plan: Fix four colors, put counters on useful creatures and protect your board so each end step adds lasting growth.
Breed Lethality.mulligan: Keep three lands, early fixing and a creature or engine that starts with counters.
Breed Lethality.tip: Proliferate adds one counter of each kind already present on each chosen permanent or player. Choose carefully.

Invent Superiority.theme: Breya makes Thopters and converts spare artifacts into damage, removal or life.
Invent Superiority.plan: Develop artifact mana, protect your useful machines and recycle expendable artifacts into Breya activations or graveyard returns.
Invent Superiority.mulligan: Keep three lands, a mana artifact and an inexpensive artifact or recursion spell.
Invent Superiority.tip: Breya’s ability costs two mana and two artifacts. Tokens can pay the sacrifice cost, and Breya can sacrifice herself.
